Definition: from an adverb form of G3592; in this same spot, i.e. here or hither:--here, hither, (in) this place, there.
BiblicalUsage: The word hōde is here, hither, (in) this place, there — a small word, used 59 times; Matthew and Mark show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hōde plainly: here, hither, (in) this place, there, and I leave it there.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac; Jesus Rejected at Nazareth
